env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Internal test files are linted in the package's test variant.
cd internal
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'in_test\.go:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
stderr -count=1 'slop::discarded_error'
cd ..

# External test packages are linted as the pxtest variant.
cd xtest
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'x_test\.go:10:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ..

# A package of only test files is linted instead of silently passing.
cd testonly
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'only_test\.go:8:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ..

# A test file with a broken import reports the load error and still
# lints the package's non-test files.
cd broken
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'is not in std'
stderr 'bad\.go:8:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ..

-- internal/go.mod --
module example.com/internal

go 1.24

-- internal/foo.go --
package foo

import "errors"

func F() error { return errors.New("x") }

-- internal/in_test.go --
package foo

import "testing"

func TestF(t *testing.T) {
	F()
}

-- xtest/go.mod --
module example.com/xtest

go 1.24

-- xtest/foo.go --
package foo

import "errors"

func F() error { return errors.New("x") }

-- xtest/x_test.go --
package foo_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/xtest"
)

func TestF(t *testing.T) {
	foo.F()
}

-- testonly/go.mod --
module example.com/testonly

go 1.24

-- testonly/only_test.go --
package testonly

import "errors"

func f() error { return errors.New("x") }

func helper() {
	f()
}

-- broken/go.mod --
module example.com/broken

go 1.24

-- broken/bad.go --
package broken

import "errors"

func M() error { return errors.New("x") }

func Caller() {
	M()
}

-- broken/bad_test.go --
package broken

import (
	"testing"

	"nonexistent/pkg"
)

func TestM(t *testing.T) { pkg.X() }
